The nightcore effect raises a song's speed and pitch at the same time. Here you can set it anywhere from 0.50x to 2.00x, and the Advanced section lets you change pitch, add reverb or bass, and choose the output quality.

Everything is processed in your browser. Your file is never uploaded and this page makes no network connections.

The best possible quality is that of your original file. An MP3 can't be improved by exporting it; a lossless format only avoids losing more.
